hypothesis: Evaluate complete prior, quantity and fresh semantic components under one unchanged priority rule for all 17 trials.
policy: First existing component alert for every trial. No replacement based on independent audit. Report all standalone component errors even if prior alerts shadow them.
source_identity: Compare exact common corpus/frontend/issue hashes across all components. The prior and quantity components also freeze case/selection metadata; R02 did not freeze those two as inputs.
provider_discovery_boundary: The archive checker validates quantity relation IR bytes, but does not traverse the discovery execution protocol. The separate R08 record seals its provider protocol, response and independent audit. Do not describe archive replay alone as complete provider provenance.
novelty: Evidence-composition validation only. The new construction capability belongs to round08; fresh review of old candidates is not new synthesis.
next_unexecuted_component_policy: If the already-designed absence/null component is later evaluated, freeze a new complete order: prior, quantity, absence/null, semantic. The new source-only constructor and pre-execution review precede the historical semantic pool uniformly. No case-specific override is permitted.
evaluation_boundary: All 17 fixed precedence decisions and 11 complete alert objects match component outputs exactly. Independent conclusions transfer by exact source, native and request identities. No alert is removed or replaced after evaluation.
component_error_accounting: Semantic alone has 6 valid, 2 invalid, 1 uncertain. The prior component shadows its invalid N01. Its invalid P2 and uncertain N03 remain emitted by the complete chain.

zero_invalid_prefix.scope: Whole-component retrospective ablation, not label-conditioned suppression.

limitations: All 17 trials are development-exposed and represent 14 tasks, not a held-out generalization study.
The fixed full chain emits 11 alerts: nine verified, one invalid and one uncertain. A failing source-controlled test alone does not establish a valid oracle.
The whole prior+quantity prefix has eight verified alerts and no invalid/uncertain emitted alerts in this cohort. It is a complete-component ablation, not a label-filtered version of the full chain.
Exact transport preserves existing invalid inputs and uncertain assertions as well as valid tests. Source controls do not establish protocol input validity.
Referenced audit conclusions transfer by byte-exact identity. No new native test, provider request or independent human review occurs in this evaluator.
decision: Retain by the frozen conservative F1 criterion (18/28). Also preserve the whole prior+quantity prefix (16/25) as the zero-invalid alternative. The F1 increase over that alternative is only 0.002857; it does not establish a practically better precision/recall tradeoff or achieve the perfect target.
